context: Two teens compare crushes on the walk home from school
purpose: Teach: あたりまえ/所詮/異様/つぎ/目当て/頬/かかわり/いのち

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえリク、最近ハルカのこと見るとき、頬がちょっと赤いよね？
lines.en: Hey Riku, when you look at Haruka lately your cheeks get a little red, right?
lines.style: Sakura teasing tone, playful sing-song accusation while walking

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: は？気のせいだって。あたりまえの反応じゃん、走ってきた直後なんだから。
lines.en: Huh? You're imagining it. That's just a normal reaction, I'd just been running.
lines.style: Riku defensive, flustered boyish denial with quick excuse

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うそだー。じゃあ私が好きな人当ててみてよ、つぎは私の番ね。
lines.en: Liar. Okay then guess who I like, it's my turn next.
lines.style: Sakura giggling, bouncing playfully as she walks beside him

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: えー、どうせタカシ先輩でしょ？所詮あの人目当てで吹奏楽の練習見に行ってたじゃん。
lines.en: Eh, it's gotta be Takashi-senpai right? In the end you only went to watch band practice for him.
lines.style: Riku smug, getting back at her with a knowing grin

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なんで知ってんの！？昨日の放課後、教室が異様に静かだったのそのせいかも…バレてた。
lines.en: How do you know that?! Maybe that's why the classroom felt weirdly quiet yesterday after school… I was found out.
lines.style: Sakura mortified, voice rising into a panicked squeak

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: クラスのほぼ全員知ってるよ。お前の片思いはもうクラスの一大イベント扱い。
lines.en: Pretty much the whole class knows. Your crush is basically a huge class event now.
lines.style: Riku deadpan delivery, barely suppressing a laugh

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やめてよー恥ずかしい。人とのかかわりって難しいよね、好きって伝えるの。
lines.en: Stop it, it's embarrassing. Dealing with people is hard, telling someone you like them.
lines.style: Sakura sighing, voice suddenly sincere and quieter than before

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん…いのちがけで伝えるしかないだろ。俺も、言うときはちゃんと言うから。
lines.en: Yeah… you just have to put your life on the line and say it. When it's time for me to say it, I will too.
lines.style: Riku quiet, rare moment of gentle honesty after the teasing
